oemNotice.title: Notice for OEM & Android 13+ Devices
oemNotice.desc: Android protects notification listener access behind special permission layers. Depending on your phone brand, follow one of the methods below.

methodA.title: Method A: Special App Access (Pixel, Motorola, Infinix, Stock)
methodA.step2: Go to Special App Access > Notification Access.
methodA.step3: Find Kruzty Dynamics and switch on Allow notification access.

methodB.title: Method B: App Info > Ellipsis (Xiaomi/HyperOS, Samsung, Oppo)
methodB.step1: Open device Settings > Apps > Manage Apps / App List.
methodB.step3: Tap the three dots at the top-right corner.
methodB.step4: Tap Allow restricted settings / Special App Access > Grant.
